method: Computer Use app-targeted native clicks, Cmd+Left/Right, BackSpace/Delete, immediate period typing, screenshots and AX states
checks: Opened quote.txt, Aa on. Cmd+Left at QuoteAfter then Backspace removed boundary. Native period inserted between QuoteBefore and QuoteAfter inside the existing quote; Following remained separate. Undo restored original blocks.
Cmd+Right at QuoteBefore then native Delete also joined QuoteAfter on the same line; immediate period landed at the join. Undo restored, repeated Delete without typing and saved the joined quote.

Opened bullet.txt as another window. Aa on, Backspace at BulletAfter start joined into the last existing bullet. Immediate period appeared at the boundary. Undo restored original blocks. Delete at BulletBefore end joined the same text with exactly two list items, then Save. Screenshot confirmed no extra bullet.

Opened number.txt, Aa on. Backspace at NumberAfter start joined into item 4. Immediate period appeared at the boundary; Undo restored separate Text. Delete at NumberBefore end joined with immediate period and retained markers 3 and 4, with no item 5. Save and reload retained the result.
Switched number, bullet and quote to Aa off and observed saved merged reading output in all three windows before Quit.
A previous temporary PS1 copy window was restored on app launch and left untouched. Existing installed/InputFix/AaOnly processes were distinct and not closed.
Cmd+Q; global inventory confirmed the dedicated JoinFix process absent. Crash reports and launchd exit logs are checked separately; this does not resolve existing bug 45.
limits: Comprehensive real IME composition is not covered.
Existing window-close crash 45 is unchanged. This run used Aa-off before Quit, so it does not exercise the failing Aa close path.
Code/isolating/atomic boundaries are not newly merged by this command; native text editing inside a block remains the existing engine path.
